name: xpscript
description: XPscript language support with repository-driven IntelliSense.

configurationSnippets.label: XPscript: Debug current file
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the currently active XPscript source file using the shared workspace launch.json. The effective runtime target is inferred from the source when target is cli.

configurationSnippets.label: XPscript: Debug specific source file
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a specific XPscript source file from this workspace. The effective runtime target is inferred from the source when target is cli.

commands.title: XPscript: Add Launch Config for Current File

xpscript.runtimeRepoPath.description: Absolute path to a local checkout of the XPscript repository.

xpscript.indexWorkspace.description: Index XPscript declarations in the current workspace.

xpscript.autoUpdate.description: Check GitHub Releases for a newer XPscript extension when the extension starts. Installation always requires explicit approval.

xpscript.debugExecutable.markdownDescription: Full path to the XPscript CLI executable used by **Run** and **Debug**. Leave empty to use `xpscript` from PATH. You can also run **XPscript: Select XPscript Executable** from the Command Palette.

scripts.generate:catalog: node scripts/generate-catalog.mjs && node scripts/augment-catalog.mjs && node scripts/sync-current-public-api.mjs && node scripts/apply-astro-docs.mjs && node scripts/apply-parameter-help.mjs && node scripts/filter-removed-api.mjs && node scripts/augment-console-catalog.mjs && node scripts/augment-recent-api.mjs
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run prepare:publish && vsce package --out publish/xpscript.vsix
